beats.care: If you got a notice or missed your hearing, act before 5 November, or you may not be able to vote.
beats.what: Data from Telangana's Chief Electoral Officer shows over 2.5 crore electors marked for the final roll, including 5.25 lakh added without hearings.
beats.why: About 92.6 lakh people got notices because their details didn't match the 2002 list or had errors like wrong spellings or ages.

cards.body: Of 3.38 crore electors before the revision, about 73 lakh were flagged in these categories during enumeration.
cards.caption: Marked absent, shifted, dead or duplicate

cards.body: Rangareddy had the most people added without hearings, about 1.17 lakh, followed by Medchal-Malkajgiri at 1.14 lakh. Hearing dates lapsed for about 3 lakh people.
A notice asking you to confirm your details. You get one if your form couldn't be matched to the 2002 roll or had mismatched details.

cards.q: Have you checked your name yet?

cards.q: Why did lakhs of Telangana voters get SIR notices?
cards.why: Notices went to people whose forms couldn't be mapped to the 2002 list or had errors, so officials could verify them.

hook: Got an SIR notice? *Over 90%* of people who did are back on the list

learn.t: Over 90% of the 92.6 lakh Telangana voters sent SIR notices have been marked for inclusion in the final roll.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Telangana SIR: Over 5.25 lakh electors marked for inclusion without hearings

tldr: Telangana's voter roll revision has marked over 2.5 crore electors for the final list, which comes out on 9 November.
watch: Claims and objections close on 5 November. The final voter list is published on 9 November.
